checked: Checked 19 Nov 2026. Every method below was read in at least two independent guides (PowerPyx plus Push Square, GTABase, sixshore or gtasix.how) and written here in fresh words. Three trophies that were unconfirmed at launch now have methods. Two are still marked NOT YET KNOWN, with their lead labelled as a lead, never as fact.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last one you earn. It pops on its own the moment the other 54 are done: no extra task, no online play, no DLC. PowerPyx and Push Square agree it is single-player only, and both put the whole run at roughly 200 to 300 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed: finish the mission and it pops.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy lands a little late: both PowerPyx and GTABase say it pops once you start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the Chapter 1 trophy it arrives just after the chapter ends: GTABase says it is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City, and PowerPyx agrees.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, according to GTABase and PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. PowerPyx ties it to the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero, and GTABase agrees it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. GTABase and Push Square both place it at the end of the story, with free roam continuing after the credits; there is no mission replay, so nothing about how you play the mission matters for trophies. Note: PowerPyx's entry for this one repeats the Chapter 4 wording, which clashes with its own Chapter 5 mission, so this guide follows GTABase and Push Square here.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. A story trophy: play the mission and it pops, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. A story trophy: play the mission and it pops, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play in Chapter 4. A story trophy: play the mission and it pops, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners in Chapter 4. A story trophy: play the mission and it pops, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. A story trophy: play the mission and it pops, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A story trophy: play the mission and it pops, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Fill the 100% Completion checklist, found under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion once the story is done. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable. PowerPyx stresses the list is lenient, closer to 60% of true completion, while Push Square warns you still need almost everything, including 15 of the 18 card sets. Either way this is the longest trophy and the last big one before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the four kinds however you like; both PowerPyx and Push Square say flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, winning a race, and a stunt. GTABase lists all nine; PowerPyx says most come naturally while you work on everything else, so check Progress, then Activities, to see what is left.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Push Square names two range sites, Rodgers Ranch and Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero, and notes some challenges stay locked until you meet their conditions. Track them under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per place is enough for the trophy, though the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so you may as well finish each location while you are there. Some locations charge an entry fee. Find them under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on the map. Winning the same race twice does not count. GTABase counts 40 race spots; Push Square adds that hired cars are available at most spots and your own car's rating can be raised with upgrades from mod shops.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you a fishing spot. Work through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge: Push Square says the ask is a parrotfish over 2kg, fished in the marked area from a boat with a rod.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any one of the four arcade games (called Video Games in-game) through to the end. Three, Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, run on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade machines around Leonida. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all five of Andy's quests: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The strand is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her an address in Belville. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand: recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. He marks purple chest icons on the map; dive, use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor, and bring it back. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and comes back later in the story, so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish all five of Billy's jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. The strand opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. PowerPyx and GTABase agree Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count, and that the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being pinned down, so watch the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list. None of them are needed for 100%, and all stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's wish list to his garage in west Vice City. The list opens in Chapter 3 once you have the Key Cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting ground, and cars in better shape pay more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City (the Take Out Kitty Litter jobs). Once enough labs are gone he hands you his last job, Spin On This, shutting the labs down, which awards the trophy. Still open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts twice at the same spot, and the last one needs both characters, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen and walks to the balcony at Jason's house. Follow her and accept. That one is gone after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx says it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it (Push Square lists no known missables at all). Do it anyway; it takes a minute.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work through Bret's hunting strand: after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks it off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Note: PowerPyx and GTABase both say which animal actually triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed. Clearing all 15 Target Decks, which 100% needs anyway, should cover it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards you have collected can be sold at pawn shops and still count. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1). Any 100 count, drawn from 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way: pick the easiest ones left once most are done naturally. Track them under Progress, then Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone: the trophy only counts once you are out of it. Call your partner with hold Right plus Triangle once both characters can roam together after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easy escape; bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often pops there anyway.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted: keep the flashing red-and-blue wanted level the whole time, not just heat. Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) sit close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough: you do not have to drive them. Stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic; the 100% checklist wants 200 base models, so this comes on the way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first: eat, drink or wash up at home, and Adrenaline stretches it. Then use an assault rifle on a group. Gang operation thugs count; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to. Raising your Focus level at shooting ranges and golf helps.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge at VCIA: planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County: the tanks stand at the south end of the base. Drive in through the gate or over the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Driving one off brings a 3-star wanted level.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 you carry the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door: kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Then find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City works well.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to its bank and slip into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. The 100% checklist wants all 8.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Robbing a bank vault counts for this too, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. Earlier, you can box in an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until nothing is left. A plane can be had early in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs: yellow icons on the map. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops on the way. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: FILLED 19 Nov: PowerPyx now gives a method. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. GTABase agrees on the core, a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach, though it had not yet pinned the exact bar or drink when checked. Treat the drink detail as PowerPyx's confirmed find.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: FILLED 19 Nov: PowerPyx now gives a method. Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. The trophy pops a little late, after you drive further down the street, and only the blue Banshee counts: a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. GTABase agrees on the showroom-window crash, though it had not confirmed the exact car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit: the robbery comes back after a long wait.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out at fitness clubs (Map, then Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. You need both characters, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. After the story you can also train at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your Criminal Profile: robberies, clean escapes, fights, anything that shifts how the law and the streets see you. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, so you can watch the count. Most players get it without trying; avoid pushing toward the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN: no guide has confirmed how this one unlocks as of 19 Nov 2026. PowerPyx, GTABase and sixshore all list it as unconfirmed. LEAD, not a fact: PowerPyx believes it may be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and GTABase notes only that 'second time's the charm' hints at succeeding on a second attempt. Try a second attempt at anything that can fail, but do not treat the Payday Loans idea as confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: FILLED 19 Nov: two sources now agree. Find the UFO random encounter on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2am, and go alone. If a car with flickering lights is waiting at the roadside, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO. Approach it, talk to the woman it drops, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is a little random: if the car is not there, drive away and come back.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN: no guide has confirmed how this one unlocks as of 19 Nov 2026. PowerPyx, GTABase and sixshore all list it as unconfirmed. LEAD, not a fact: the description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx believes it may be kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Try melee kicks from a bike, but that is a guess, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a running total of $250,000 in marked bills through fences. First finish Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 to get the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and sell the marked bills to a fence: Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so the robberies for 100% get you there.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a running total of $100,000 across all shops: every kind counts. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they get you there fastest. Find shops under Touch Pad, then Style.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, about $160,000 in total: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. The app arrives after Daily Driver in Chapter 2. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after Moses' Chapter 2 mission; take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space first, so pair this with Little Boxes, and use cheap cars and bikes: each registration costs money.
